programs.title: Rock Paper Scissors
programs.sub_title: Paper Takes the Phones; The Bedtime Story
programs.desc: Rock can't sleep, so Paper and Scissors must tell him a bedtime story, but he's hard to please. Paper takes Rock and Scissors' cellphones, so the trio can connect in real life, but it turns out to be the worst day ever to be off-the-grid.

programs.title: Sonic Prime
programs.desc: To get help in the fight against Nine and his winged lackeys, Sonic heads to New Yoke and forms an allegiance with the very last people he ever expected.

programs.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programs.desc: SpongeBob can't drive, but he learns one does not need a license to operate a self-driving car; Patrick thinks he is an old man, so SpongeBob tries to remind him how much fun being a child can be.

programs.title: Trolls World Tour
programs.desc: Poppy and Branch discover that there are six different troll tribes scattered over six different lands. Each tribe is also devoted to six different kinds of music -- funk, country, techno, classical, pop and rock. When rockers Queen Barb and King Thrash set out to destroy the other music, Poppy and Branch embark on a daring mission to unite the trolls and save the diverse melodies from becoming extinct.

programs.title: Friends
programs.desc: The gang goes to the opening night of Joey's plays; Rachel brings a date (Ben Stiller) to make Ross jealous; Joey's play gets terrible reviews, but his co-star provides some comfort.

programs.title: Friends
